rootCauseHypothesis:
The hosting build likely has a state-management bug in the demo’s restart/pause logic: after restart, a delayed timer or effect continues advancing the round, or the restart handler restores only part of the state. As a result, the app ends up paused on Round 2 / 2 with updated vote totals instead of remaining on Round 1 / 2 for verification. This is consistent with a race condition or stale interval cleanup problem in the production bundle rather than a hosting outage. Underlying error: TEST FAILURE

The demo did not remain on Round 1 / 2 after the restart-and-pause sequence, so the required Round 1 totals and final playing state could not be verified.

Observations:
- The demo is paused on Round 2 / 2.
- Majority needed is 140,686; Golden shows 142,440 and Poliquin shows 138,931.

recommendedFixTarget.rationale: Inspect the restart-and-pause flow in the hosted app and make sure the restart action fully resets the demo state to Round 1 / 2 before resuming. Likely fixes include: resetting the round index and any derived totals on restart, clearing stale interval/timer state so the next tick starts from the first round again, and ensuring the pause button truly freezes the current round instead of allowing a queued state update to advance to Round 2. If the round progression is driven by asynchronous state updates, use a single source of truth and atomic state transitions so restart cannot leave the app paused on Round 2.
